name: Me follan las princesas del reino
source: You live in Drosk, a dusty land... and where you don't throw any. One day, a crazy old man tells you that beyond the Red Valley there is a kingdom where only beautiful and hot women live. Without hesitation, you head straight for the steamy tale you've just been told, and you find out it's real.
